subject: CloudScope renewal: evidence window, staggered capacity uplift, and billing split
messages:
From: Amelia Harper <amelia@cloudscope.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: daniel.ortiz@cloudscope.com, lara.singh@cloudscope.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity uplift timing and evidence for marketplace PO

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. CloudScope is ready to move forward with the renewal in AWS Marketplace but we have a couple of constraints to surface up front:

- We need the renewal term to align with our fiscal Q3 start (effective 2027-07-01) rather than immediate start. Can Redwood do a prorated transition period so existing spend covers May–Jun and the new commitment begins 7/1?
- We want a staged capacity uplift: 1) baseline 6 months, 2) automatic uplift to +30% on 2027-10-01 if usage thresholds are met. Can that be modeled as a private offer with staggered acceptance?
- Security/compliance: our procurement requires a SOC 2 evidence pack and a one-week evidence window to review attachments before final PO approval. Please send the evidence list and expected turnaround.

We also expect to route the marketplace PO through our finance team and will need an invoice split (EU entity + US entity) — I can share tax IDs once we confirm the billing flow.

Appreciate a quick sketch of how Redwood typically handles staggered activations and evidence delivery for marketplace private offers.

Best,
Amelia Harper
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudScope, Inc.


From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Amelia Harper <amelia@cloudscope.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift timing and evidence for marketplace PO

Amelia — thanks for the clear ask; happy to outline the path. High level: yes, we can do a prorated bridging period and a staged uplift via a private offer in the marketplace. Proposed next steps: 

1) I will attach the SOC2 evidence checklist and a mapped timeline for a one-week review (attachment: CloudScope_SOC2_Evidence_List.xlsx).
2) Ben (cc) will draft the marketplace private offer language that encodes: 2027-05-01 – 2027-06-30 (bridging spend applied), new term starts 2027-07-01 for 12 months; scheduled uplift on 2027-10-01 to +30% conditional on usage thresholds.
3) Marissa (cc) on finance will confirm invoice split options and whether we can emit two invoices (EU entity + US entity) or provide a consolidated invoice with tax breakdown.
4) We will provide a DocuSign-ready PO and send the private offer URL for acceptance; allow a 7–10 day review window for SOC2 artifacts before exec approval.

Attachments: CloudScope_SOC2_Evidence_List.xlsx (see sheet: required artifacts + sample TTLs).

Two quick questions so we can model correctly: do you want the uplift to be automatic if thresholds are met, or require explicit acceptance by your finance lead? Also, please confirm which legal entity should sign the private offer.

Irene Choi
Sr. Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, Amelia Harper <amelia@cloudscope.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift timing and evidence for marketplace PO

Amelia — looping in finance/legal ops to propose private offer language. Draft summary below (will attach formal PDF):

- Term: 2027-07-01 through 2028-06-30
- Bridging credit: Redwood will honor customer usage from 2027-05-01 to 2027-06-30 and apply credit toward the first invoice under the new term.
- Staged uplift: On 2027-10-01 Redwood will increase committed capacity by 30% automatically if rolling 30-day consumption > 75% of committed baseline for 2 consecutive weeks. If the threshold is met, Redwood will notify CloudScope and emit an invoice for the prorated delta; CloudScope will have a 10-business-day window to request a cap hold.
- Billing split: We can produce two invoices to two entities but will need the tax IDs and a signed PO for each entity. Alternative: single consolidated invoice with EU VAT breakdown.
- Evidence window: SOC2 evidence artifacts to be delivered via secure share; CloudScope will have 7 business days to request follow-ups.

Attachment: CloudScope_PO_DRAFT_v2.pdf (terms & billing options).

Ben Carter
Head of Cloud Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@cloudscope.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: amelia@cloudscope.com, lara.singh@cloudscope.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 12:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift timing and evidence for marketplace PO

Thanks Ben — that structure looks workable from procurement. A couple of clarifications from finance: 

- The uplift being automatic is preferred but we require a 5-business-day notice before the invoice is issued so we can prepare internal accounting. Can you change notification window from immediate to 5 business days?
- For the bridging credit: will the credit be applied to the first invoice for the new term or issued as a separate credit memo? We prefer a single invoice with credit applied.

We will provide tax IDs and confirm signing entity by EOD tomorrow. Also, please send the secure link for SOC2 artifacts — we will start the review as soon as we get it.

—Daniel
Director, Procurement
CloudScope, Inc.

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: amelia@cloudscope.com, daniel.ortiz@cloudscope.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift timing and evidence for marketplace PO

Daniel/Amelia — confirmed on the two items below and next actions: 

- Notification window updated: Redwood will issue an uplift notice 5 business days before the scheduled invoice date. If CloudScope requests a cap hold within that window, we will pause the uplift for 30 days and re-evaluate.
- Bridging credit: credit will be reflected on the first invoice of the new term as a line item credit (not a separate memo).

I've attached the DocuSign-ready PO and the draft private offer. Please countersign the DocuSign envelope (link below) and share the tax IDs for the two billing entities. Once signed, we'll publish the private offer in AWS Marketplace and begin the SOC2 artifact share (secure link will follow immediately after acceptance).

Attachments: DocuSign_Authorize_PO.link; CloudScope_PO_DRAFT_v2.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line early next week.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Finance Lead
Redwood Inference
